notes:
Account summary: mid-market regional healthcare provider evaluating LLM assistants for patient support, clinical doc search, and clinician summarization. Primary ask: private deployment/VPC or on-prem with strict data residency and KMS integration. Security team required SOC2 + ISO27001 + audit logging.

Timeline / outcome: gone quiet in late Feb; procurement chose direct integration with OpenAI/Anthropic citing simplicity and brand trust — "preferred vendor" language from procurement. Security team felt Redwood's private offering met requirements but procurement pushed for fewer integration touchpoints. POC had positive technical feedback (prefix caching, routing policies), but cost and speed-to-launch trumped advanced routing. Team quote on final call: "We need the path of least resistance — fastest to production, fewer approvals."

Stalled signals observed: slow replies from technical champion after org reorg (head of automation left), procurement requested single-vendor LLM provider for vendor consolidation. Also new CFO-imposed Q1 hiring/hardware budget freeze — pushed for SaaS managed offering (ChatGPT Enterprise / Anthropic enterprise) over Dedicated/Private commit.

Competitive notes: OpenAI offered trial credits + simplified SSO setup and existing medical partner integrations via a systems integrator they already use. Anthropic engaged separately with a partner that proposed a lighter-weight integration. Both vendors emphasized lower near-term engineering lift.

What we tried: demo tailored to clinical workflows, security deep-dive with SE, custom cost model and 12-month staged rollout proposal, draft contract with data residency clauses.

Why lost (short): procurement/branding + speed to market > advanced controls. No clear internal champion after reorg. Budget freeze removed appetite for Dedicated.

Recovery plan: tag as closed-lost, set reminder for Sep 2026 to re-open during next budget cycle; offer lightweight hosted pilot with strict residency terms if procurement reconsiders. Track any RFPs from their SI partner.
